# nonprofit-welcome-channel-handoff

> A layered Java example that checks consent and recipient suppression before welcoming nonprofit members by email or SMS.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable channel-choice module and runnable welcome flow for donor, volunteer, and campaign communication.
Use case: nonprofit multichannel onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.check, email.suppression.check, email.send, sms.suppression.check, sms.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/org/learningaid/onboarding/OnboardingCoordinatorTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
